stop-go.name: Stop / Go (STOP/RY-GO)
stop-go.meaning: Two signs mounted back to back, used mostly at road works: stop when STOP is shown; proceed with caution when GO is shown.

stop.name: Stop
stop.meaning: Stop behind the stop line (or in line with the sign if there is no line); proceed only when it is safe.

stop-yield.name: Stop / yield (left turn)
stop-yield.meaning: Stop if going straight or turning right; traffic turning left may do so without stopping, but must yield to all traffic close enough to be a hazard.

stop-3way.name: 3-way stop
stop-3way.meaning: All three approaches must stop; the vehicle that stopped first moves off first.

stop-4way.name: 4-way stop
stop-4way.meaning: All four approaches must stop; the vehicle that stopped first moves off first.

yield.name: Yield
yield.meaning: Yield to other traffic: slow down and stop if necessary.

yield-ped.name: Yield to pedestrians
yield-ped.meaning: Give priority to pedestrians crossing or wanting to cross; be ready to stop.

yield-circle.name: Yield at traffic circle (mini-circle)
yield-circle.meaning: Yield to vehicles already in the circle or that will cross their yield line before you cross yours; first to reach the yield line goes first.

no-entry.name: No entry
no-entry.meaning: No traffic may proceed past the sign (e.g. the wrong end of a one-way street).

oneway-left.name: One-way roadway (to the left)
oneway-left.meaning: The road in the direction of the arrow is a one-way roadway.

oneway-ahead.name: One-way roadway (ahead)
oneway-ahead.meaning: The road ahead is a one-way roadway.

ped-priority.name: Pedestrian priority
ped-priority.meaning: Area intended for pedestrians; only emergency, loading/off-loading and maintenance vehicles, max 15 km/h, giving pedestrians priority.

yield-oncoming.name: Yield to oncoming traffic
yield-oncoming.meaning: Single carriageway ahead for both directions: yield to vehicles already in it.

min-speed.name: Minimum speed (50 km/h)
min-speed.meaning: Do not drive slower than the speed shown.

mass-only.name: Vehicles exceeding 10 t only
mass-only.meaning: Vehicles with a GVM/GCM over the mass shown must use this road or lane.

keep-left.name: Keep left
keep-left.meaning: Pass to the left of the obstruction.

keep-right.name: Keep right
keep-right.meaning: Pass to the right of the obstruction.

proceed-left.name: Proceed left only
proceed-left.meaning: Drive only in the direction of the arrow (left).

turn-left.name: Turn left only
turn-left.meaning: At the intersection ahead you must turn left.

turn-right.name: Turn right only
turn-right.meaning: At the intersection ahead you must turn right.

ped-only.name: Pedestrians only
ped-only.meaning: Road or part of road for pedestrians only.

cycle-only.name: Pedal cyclists only
cycle-only.meaning: Road or part of road for cyclists only.

cycle-ped-split.name: Cyclists and pedestrians only (divided)
cycle-ped-split.meaning: Divided path: cyclists use the side with the bicycle, pedestrians the side with the pedestrian.

mc-only.name: Motorcycles only
mc-only.meaning: Road or lane for motorcycles only.

mc-only-t.name: Motorcycles only (temporary)
mc-only-t.meaning: Temporary version: road or lane for motorcycles only.

car-only.name: Motor cars only
car-only.meaning: Road or lane for motor cars only.

taxi-only.name: Taxis only
taxi-only.meaning: Road or lane set aside for taxis.

minibus-only.name: Minibuses only
minibus-only.meaning: Road or lane set aside for minibuses.

bus-only.name: Buses only
bus-only.meaning: Road or lane set aside for buses.

delivery-only.name: Delivery vehicles only
delivery-only.meaning: Road or lane set aside for delivery vehicles.

goods-only.name: Goods vehicles only
goods-only.meaning: Road or lane set aside for goods vehicles.

construction-only.name: Construction vehicles only
construction-only.meaning: Road set aside for construction vehicles.

hazmat-only.name: Vehicles transporting dangerous substances only
hazmat-only.meaning: Road set aside for vehicles conveying dangerous goods.

abnormal-only.name: Abnormal vehicles only
abnormal-only.meaning: Road set aside for abnormal vehicles.

tour-only.name: Tour buses only
tour-only.meaning: Road set aside for tour buses.

agri-only.name: Agricultural vehicles only
agri-only.meaning: Road set aside for agricultural vehicles.

animal-drawn-only.name: Animal-drawn vehicles only
animal-drawn-only.meaning: Road set aside for animal-drawn vehicles.

pay-toll.name: Pay toll
pay-toll.meaning: Last chance to take an alternative route; if you carry on, you must pay toll.

headlamps-on.name: Switch headlamps on
headlamps-on.meaning: Switch on your headlights (dipped) to see and be seen, e.g. before a tunnel.

roundabout.name: Roundabout
roundabout.meaning: Move clockwise; yield to vehicles approaching from the right within the roundabout.

speed-100.name: Speed limit 100 km/h
speed-100.meaning: Do not exceed 100 km/h; the limit applies from the sign.

speed-60.name: Speed limit 60 km/h
speed-60.meaning: Do not exceed 60 km/h; the limit applies from the sign.

speed-100-t.name: Temporary speed limit 100 km/h
speed-100-t.meaning: Temporary speed limit: do not exceed 100 km/h.

mass-limit.name: Mass limit (12 t)
mass-limit.meaning: Vehicles with GVM/GCM over 12 t may not use this road.

axle-mass.name: Axle mass limit (2 t)
axle-mass.meaning: Vehicles with any axle heavier than the mass shown may not use this road.

height-limit.name: Height limit (4,42 m)
height-limit.meaning: Vehicles (including load) higher than 4,42 m may not proceed.

length-limit.name: Length limit (15 m)
length-limit.meaning: Vehicles longer than 15 m may not proceed.

no-noise.name: Excessive noise prohibited
no-noise.meaning: No excessive noise; do not use your hooter for 100 m after the sign.

no-hitchhike.name: Hitch-hiking prohibited
no-hitchhike.meaning: Pedestrians may not hitch-hike and drivers may not pick up passengers for the next 500 m.

no-unauthorised.name: Unauthorised vehicles prohibited
no-unauthorised.meaning: Do not proceed past the sign without special permission.

no-left-ahead.name: Left turn ahead prohibited
no-left-ahead.meaning: You may not turn left at the intersection ahead.

no-right-ahead.name: Right turn ahead prohibited
no-right-ahead.meaning: You may not turn right at the intersection ahead.

no-left.name: Left turn prohibited
no-left.meaning: No left turn here; you may go straight or turn right.

no-right.name: Right turn prohibited
no-right.meaning: No right turn here; you may go straight or turn left.

no-uturn.name: U-turn prohibited
no-uturn.meaning: Do not turn your vehicle around to face the opposite direction.

no-overtaking.name: Overtaking prohibited
no-overtaking.meaning: Do not overtake any vehicle for the next 500 m.

no-overtaking-goods.name: Overtaking prohibited for goods vehicles
no-overtaking-goods.meaning: Drivers of heavy (goods) vehicles may not overtake other heavy vehicles for the next 500 m.

no-parking.name: Parking prohibited
no-parking.meaning: Do not park here (you may stop briefly).

no-stopping.name: Stopping prohibited
no-stopping.meaning: Do not stop, except to obey a traffic light or officer, or to avoid a collision.

no-peds.name: Pedestrians prohibited
no-peds.meaning: Pedestrians may not proceed; still watch out for them.

no-cycles.name: Pedal cycles prohibited
no-cycles.meaning: Cyclists may not proceed past the sign.

no-cycles-peds.name: Pedal cycles and pedestrians prohibited
no-cycles-peds.meaning: Cyclists and pedestrians may not proceed past the sign.

no-mc.name: Motorcycles prohibited
no-mc.meaning: Motorcycles may not enter (on a freeway, leave at the first exit).

no-taxis.name: Taxis prohibited
no-taxis.meaning: Taxis may not proceed beyond the sign.

no-minibus.name: Minibuses prohibited
no-minibus.meaning: Minibuses may not proceed beyond the sign.

no-buses.name: Buses prohibited
no-buses.meaning: Buses may not proceed beyond the sign.

no-goods.name: Goods vehicles prohibited
no-goods.meaning: Goods vehicles may not proceed beyond the sign.

no-hazmat.name: Vehicles transporting dangerous substances prohibited
no-hazmat.meaning: Vehicles carrying dangerous goods may not proceed.

no-agri.name: Agricultural vehicles prohibited
no-agri.meaning: Tractors / agricultural vehicles may not proceed.

no-horses.name: Horses and riders prohibited
no-horses.meaning: Horses and riders (mounted or leading) may not proceed.

width-limit.name: Width limit (2,1 m)
width-limit.meaning: Vehicles wider than 2,1 m may not proceed.

no-towing.name: Towed vehicles prohibited
no-towing.meaning: No vehicle towing another vehicle or trailer may proceed.

no-hawkers.name: Hawkers prohibited
no-hawkers.meaning: Hawkers prohibited; do not stop or park for hawkers here.

bus-stop.name: Bus stop reservation
bus-stop.meaning: Only buses of the indicated operator may stop here to pick up or drop off passengers.

freeway.name: Dual-carriageway freeway begins
freeway.meaning: A dual-carriageway freeway (separate roadways for each direction) begins; freeway rules apply from here.

freeway-single.name: Single-carriageway freeway begins
freeway-single.meaning: A single-carriageway freeway (one roadway carrying both directions) begins; freeway rules apply from here.

woonerf.name: Woonerf
woonerf.meaning: Residential "living street": max 30 km/h, pedestrians have right of way, no through traffic, no vehicles over 3 500 kg or with more than 10 seats except local access/delivery.

daytime.name: Daytime (supplementary plate)
daytime.meaning: The sign above it applies during daytime only.

nighttime.name: Night-time (supplementary plate)
nighttime.meaning: The sign above it applies at night only.

pay-display.name: Pay and display
pay-display.meaning: Pay the parking fee and display the receipt in your vehicle.

crossroad.name: Crossroad
crossroad.meaning: A crossroad is ahead: approach cautiously and be able to stop.

priority-crossroad.name: Priority crossroad
priority-crossroad.meaning: Crossroad ahead where YOU have right of way (thicker line = priority road); still be ready to stop if cross-traffic does not yield.

secondary-crossroad.name: Secondary crossroad
secondary-crossroad.meaning: Crossroad ahead where you must yield to cross-traffic (the thick line is the priority road).

t-junction.name: T-junction
t-junction.meaning: Road ends at a T-junction ahead: you will have to turn left or right.

side-road-left.name: Side road junction from the left
side-road-left.meaning: A side road joins from the left ahead.

side-road-right.name: Side road junction from the right
side-road-right.meaning: A side road joins from the right ahead.

y-junction.name: Y-junction
y-junction.meaning: The road forks into two roads ahead.

traffic-circle.name: Traffic circle ahead
traffic-circle.meaning: Traffic circle ahead; slow down and be ready to yield.

gentle-curve-right.name: Gentle curve to the right
gentle-curve-right.meaning: A gentle curve to the right is ahead.

gentle-curve-left.name: Gentle curve to the left
gentle-curve-left.meaning: A gentle curve to the left is ahead.

sharp-curve-right.name: Sharp curve to the right
sharp-curve-right.meaning: A sharp curve to the right is ahead: slow down.

sharp-curve-left.name: Sharp curve to the left
sharp-curve-left.meaning: A sharp curve to the left is ahead: slow down.

hairpin-right.name: Hairpin bend to the right
hairpin-right.meaning: A very sharp U-shaped curve to the right is ahead.

hairpin-left.name: Hairpin bend to the left
hairpin-left.meaning: A very sharp U-shaped curve to the left is ahead.

winding-road.name: Winding road
winding-road.meaning: A series of curves is ahead (more may follow without further warning).

two-way.name: Two-way traffic
two-way.meaning: The one-way road you are on will soon carry two-way traffic.

two-way-crossroad.name: Two-way traffic crossroad
two-way-crossroad.meaning: Your one-way street will be crossed by a street with two-way traffic.

signals-ahead.name: Traffic signals ahead
signals-ahead.meaning: Traffic lights ahead: slow down and be ready to stop.

stop-ahead.name: Stop sign ahead
stop-ahead.meaning: A stop sign is ahead that you may not see in time: slow down and be ready to stop.

yield-ahead.name: Yield sign ahead
yield-ahead.meaning: A yield sign is ahead: slow down and be ready to stop.

officer-ahead.name: Traffic control (officer) ahead
officer-ahead.meaning: A traffic officer is controlling traffic ahead.

scholar-patrol.name: Scholar patrol ahead
scholar-patrol.meaning: A scholar patrol is operating ahead: slow down and watch for children and the stop sign.

ped-crossing.name: Pedestrian crossing ahead
ped-crossing.meaning: A demarcated pedestrian crossing is ahead; do not overtake vehicles stopped at it.

pedestrians.name: Pedestrians
pedestrians.meaning: Pedestrians may be crossing for the next 2 km.

children.name: Children
children.meaning: Children may be crossing or playing in the road.

cyclists.name: Pedal cyclists
cyclists.meaning: Cyclists may be on or crossing the road for the next 2 km.

cattle.name: Domestic animals (cattle)
cattle.meaning: Free-roaming domestic animals may be on the road for the next 2 km.

wild-animals.name: Wild animals
wild-animals.meaning: Wild animals may be on or crossing the road for the next 2 km.

gate.name: Gate
gate.meaning: A gate or boom across the road is ahead.

railway.name: Railway crossing ahead
railway.meaning: A railway crossing is ahead: slow down, look both ways and stop in time if a train is coming.

tunnel.name: Tunnel
tunnel.meaning: A tunnel is ahead: slow down and switch on headlights (dipped).

height-restricted.name: Height restriction ahead (4,42 m)
height-restricted.meaning: A structure ahead is only 4,42 m high.

slow-heavy.name: Slow-moving heavy vehicles
slow-heavy.meaning: Heavy vehicles travel slowly on the steep road ahead.

gravel-begins.name: Gravel road begins
gravel-begins.meaning: The tarred road changes to gravel: slow down, steering is lighter and stopping distances longer.

narrow-bridge.name: Narrow bridge
narrow-bridge.meaning: The road narrows over a bridge: try not to cross at the same time as an oncoming vehicle.

one-vehicle-width.name: One-vehicle-width structure
one-vehicle-width.meaning: Only one vehicle at a time can pass: if there is oncoming traffic, stop at least 6 m from the structure and yield.

narrows-both.name: Road narrows from both sides
narrows-both.meaning: The road ahead narrows from both sides.

uneven.name: Uneven roadway
uneven.meaning: A dip, ridge or potholes ahead.

slippery.name: Slippery road
slippery.meaning: Unusually slippery road ahead for the next 2 km: avoid sudden braking or steering.

falling-rocks.name: Falling rocks
falling-rocks.meaning: Rocks could fall onto the road.

road-works.name: Road works
road-works.meaning: Temporary construction or maintenance works ahead.

grader.name: Grader working
grader.meaning: A grader is working on the road ahead.

soft-shoulder.name: Soft shoulder
soft-shoulder.meaning: The road shoulder is soft: do not drive or stop on it.

stop-go-ahead.name: Stop/Go control ahead
stop-go-ahead.meaning: Traffic ahead is controlled by a Stop/Go sign: slow down and get ready to stop.

truck-crossing.name: Truck crossing (temporary)
truck-crossing.meaning: Heavy vehicles regularly cross or join the road ahead.

emergency-light.name: Emergency flashing light
emergency-light.meaning: Hazard ahead; look out for signs showing what it is.

police-light.name: Temporary police flashing light
police-light.meaning: Police on duty ahead (roadblock, collision scene): be ready to stop.

jetty.name: Jetty edge or river bank
jetty.meaning: The road leads to a jetty edge or river bank.

crosswind.name: Crosswinds
crosswind.meaning: Strong crosswinds may push your vehicle off course.

drift.name: Drift
drift.meaning: A drift (low water crossing) ahead may be flooded.

aircraft.name: Low-flying aircraft
aircraft.meaning: Low-flying aircraft and sudden noise: do not brake suddenly.

agri-vehicles.name: Agricultural vehicles
agri-vehicles.meaning: Tractors or slow farm vehicles may cross or enter the road.

collision.name: Collision ahead
collision.meaning: A collision scene is ahead: slow down and be ready to stop; do not stop out of curiosity.

reduced-visibility.name: Reduced visibility
reduced-visibility.meaning: Fog or smoke may reduce visibility ahead.

horse-riders.name: Horses and riders
horse-riders.meaning: Horses and riders may be on the road ahead.

elephant.name: Elephants
elephant.meaning: Elephants may be on the road ahead.

width-warning.name: Width restriction ahead (2,1 m)
width-warning.meaning: The road ahead is restricted to vehicles 2,1 m wide or less.

electric.name: Electrical shock
electric.meaning: Risk of electrical shock from overhead power cables ahead.

railway-crossbuck.name: Railway crossing (single track)
railway-crossbuck.meaning: A railway crossing with one track; if no stop line, stop no closer than 3 m from the nearest rail.

chevron.name: Sharp curve chevron (curve to the left)
chevron.meaning: The road curves sharply to the left; slow down.

signals-out.name: Traffic signals out of order
signals-out.meaning: The traffic lights ahead are not working: slow down, yield and be ready to stop.

cul-de-sac.name: Cul-de-sac (side road to the right)
cul-de-sac.meaning: The side road to the right is a dead end (no through road).

right-of-way.name: Right of way
right-of-way.meaning: You have right of way at the intersection ahead.

coordinated-signals.name: Co-ordinated traffic signals
coordinated-signals.meaning: If you keep to the speed shown, the following traffic lights should be green (a recommendation, not a limit).

multi-phase.name: Multi-phase traffic signals
multi-phase.meaning: These lights do not follow the normal sequence: wait for your own green, even if opposing traffic moves.
